source: kit/vfx/study.luau over every vetted Roblox file in _downloads (3651 read, 232 effects with >= 6 ParticleEmitters, 6016 emitters, 964 beams/trails), 2026-10-14
front_loaded_meaning: the least transparent moment falls in the first 35 % of the particle's life
lessons: about HALF the layers are NOT additive (LightEmission 0): dark / solid shapes hold contrast and colour; all-additive washes out to white
black on Roblox = normal-blended dark particles (LightEmission 0), not glowing meshes
short lives (median 0.58 s) layered many times beat a few long shapes
front-loaded curves: pop in at once, fade over the rest of the life
streaks / shards = VelocityParallel; ring and wind discs = VelocityPerpendicular
